sam_csm: Quillify onboarding hit a wall — Cloud Run jobs spawn ~50 containers on deploy and their SDK preflight /v1/sessions gets 429s. Customers blocked. Posting logs.
ling_cs_eng: account=quillify-prod, hosted. paste sample response/body if available.
sam_csm: customer sent: `{\"error\":\"rate_limited\",\"msg\":\"too many session preflights\"}`. No Retry-After header.
ara_sre: classic coldstart fanout. Likely ephemeral token fetched per-container. Can we see request headers (any x-install-id)?
sam_csm: none. They said each container runs init that calls auth + sessions sync.
mike_devex: short fix for them: cache ephemeral token in process-global scope for ~30-60s and add 50-200ms jitter on startup. also add header `x-instance-id` to tie logs to container. I'll paste a tiny Node snippet.
mike_devex: ```js
// global scope
let _token = null
let _exp = 0
async function getToken(){
  if(Date.now() < _exp && _token) return _token
  const r = await fetch('https://auth.quillify.com/ephemeral')
  _token = await r.text()
  _exp = Date.now() + 45000
  return _token
}
async function preflight(){
  await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r, Math.random()*200))
  const t = await getToken()
  return fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions',{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${t}`,'x-instance-id':process.env.HOSTNAME}})
}
```
